title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashod Bateman hauls in one pass in Week 8
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught 1-of-3 targets for 22 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Bateman led the team in receiving yards, but there was not much going for any of the Ravens' pass catchers in Week 8. Fantasy managers should expect Bateman to struggle again if Tyler Huntley (toe) is unable to play in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane held to one reception in Week 8
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane caught his lone target for 13 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Lane's one target sets a new season low for the rookie. The passing attack was clearly not the same after losing both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Lane and the passing game to struggle if Huntley is unable to play in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zay Flowers held without a catch in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Zay Flowers did not record a reception on five targets in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' receivers struggled with both Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) exiting the game with injuries. Jackson is expected to be placed on IR and Huntley's status is uncertain for Week 9. If Huntley is unable to play, Flowers and the rest of the Ravens' pass catchers should be downgraded in a matchup with Jacksonville.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Justice Hill sees seven touches in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Justice Hill rushed for 15 yards on three carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught 4-of-8 targets for 20 yards.
items.impact: Hill continues to see limited carries, but remains a factor in the passing game. His eight targets are a season high and he could be in line for more with a rookie Joe Fagnano potentially starting in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Derrick Henry rushed for 53 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught both of his targets for seven yards.
items.impact: Henry found the end zone for the first time since Week 4 against the Titans. With Lamar Jackson (thumb) headed to IR and Tyler Huntley's (toe) status uncertain for Week 9, Henry could be in line for a lot of work against the Jaguars in Week 9.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Lamar Jackson (thumb)will need surgery for thumb, heading to IR
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will require surgery on his injured thumb and will head to injured reserve.
items.impact: It's a brutal loss for the Ravens and fantasy managers depending on Lamar's return. The Ravens offense struggled to get anything going with Lamar out, and it wasn't helped when backup Tyler Huntley also went down with injury. Jackson will now miss at least the next four games, and quite possibly more.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jacoby Brissett benched Sunday
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett has been benched by the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Darren Urban.
items.impact: Brissett was taken out after completing 10-of-23 pass attempts for 119 yards and one interception. Backup Gardner Minshew has taken over behind center against the Cowboys Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Huntley (toe) ruled out
items.desc: The Ravens have ruled out QB Tyler Huntley with a toe injury.
items.impact: Huntley replaced the injured Lamar Jackson (thumb) after just one play. He was eventually replaced by rookie QB Joe Fagnano, who will now quarterback the team for the remainder of the day. Huntley finished the game 2-for-4 with no yardage gained prior to the injury.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) active for Week 8
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (chest) is officially active for Week 8 for the Denver Broncos against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Waddle is good to go after clearing through pregame activities without any setbacks for head coach Sean Payton, as the wideout will look to get back on track against a shorthanded Kansas City secondary.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) officially inactive for Week 8
items.desc: Rams TE Colby Parkinson (ribs) is officially inactive for a Week 8 matchup with the Chargers.
items.impact: Parkinson was listed as questionable to suit up this week. Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen will see an uptick in playing time with Parkinson unavailable.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is questionable to return for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Love suffered the apparent ankle injury in the second quarter, rushing nine times for 23 yards prior to exiting. Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier will see increased touches out of the Arizona backfield in Love's absence.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (head/knee) returns to sideline Sunday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (head/knee) has returned to Sunday's contest between the Detroit Lions and Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: St. Brown exited in the first quarter while being evaluated for multiple injuries, but looks good to go for head coach Dan Campbell against a fierce Vikings defense.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Ferguson (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (ankle) is questionable to return for the Dallas Cowboys Sunday according to Jane Slater.
items.impact: Ferguson went down early in the first quarter for head coach Brian Schottenheimer, failing to register a target prior to exiting.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings declines trade to 49ers
items.desc: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings reportedly declined a trade that would have sent him back to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Jennings spent the past five seasons in San Francisco before signing with Minnesota this past offseason. He will remain off the fantasy radar with the Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat drawing trade interest
items.desc: ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that teams are showing interest in Cardinals OLB Josh Sweat.
items.impact: Schefter mentions the Cowboys as a team to watch for Sweat. This will remain a rumor to monitor heading into next week.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8
items.desc: Falcons WR Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8.
items.impact: Zaccheaus was limited in practice all week but will suit up against Tampa Bay. He will likely serve as the WR3, offering limited fantasy value.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) active for Week 8
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell (hip) is officially active for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Brianna Dix.
items.impact: Gainwell will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Tampa Bay backfield that will utilize both Gainwell and Bucky Irving against the Falcons Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) officially inactive for Week 8
items.desc: Falcons RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) is officially inactive for a Week 8 matchup with Tampa Bay.
items.impact: Robinson was unable to practice in any capacity this week and will not suit up for the Falcons. Khalil Herbert will serve as the backup against Tampa Bay.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) active for Week 8
items.desc: Calvin Ridley (hip) is active for Week 8 for the Tennessee Titans according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Ridley is good to go after carrying a questionable designation into the weekend for head coach Robert Saleh, offering an underwhelming Tennessee offense another explosive option Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) active for Week 8
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is active for Week 8 for the Jacksonville Jaguars according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Meyers will take the field after not suffering any setbacks during pregame warmups for head coach Liam Cohen, offering quarterback Trevor Lawrence another impactful pass-catcher Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) inactive for Week 8
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) is inactive for Week 8 for the New York Jets against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Hall will remain sidelined once again for head coach Aaron Glenn, with Braelon Allen once again in line for a sizeable workload leading the Jets backfield Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) active for Week 8
items.desc: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is officially active for Week 8 for the Dallas Cowboys against the Arizona Cardinals according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Pickens is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation for head coach Brian Schottenheimer, boosting a Dallas passing offense that will look to feast on the Cardinals defense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (chest) active for Week 8
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (chest) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Kincaid will take the field after passing through pregame warmups without any setbacks, offering quarterback Josh Allen one of his more impactful red zone weapons against the Ravens Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 8
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Moore is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, boosting a Buffalo passing attack for quarterback Josh Allen against the Ravens Sunday.
